native_preview_comparison.method: Each native cell alpha-composited onto exact preview background then scaled3×nearest in memory; exact RGB compared with192×192 source-preview sprite region at grid inset3. No images were saved.

animation_order: Native/preview cells are frame-major: frame1 S,N,E,W then frame2 S,N,E,W then frame3 S,N,E,W. Repack into4columns to preserve all3frames visibly.
color_and_identity_constraints: Olive/dark-green skin, large dark-edged pointed ears, brownish head shading, bright yellow awake eyes, and small pale teeth.
Sleep frame1 has dark closed/relaxed eyes. Sleep frame2 is a white cloud/black-Z graphic without a goblin.
Red source stump markers identify intentionally absent limbs; keep their locations and do not replace with intact extremities.
Retain walking-frame variation across3frames per animated state, rather than copying one standing pose3times.
notes: Page01 reserved for root generation; do not duplicate.
All98 native metadata cells appear exactly in the source preview;2trailing atlas cells are empty padding.
Full native state names, metadata fields, cell mappings, and per-frame occupied pixels retained.
No image generation, image saves, or shared manifest edits performed.
Visual reference production plan only; native runtime compatibility requires separate validation.
